lesson.initial_question: What experience and hours does the advertisement require, and how should Mina apply?
lesson.initial_answer: Professional experience, Saturday from nine to five, and an application with a CV by email.
lesson.topic: reading a hotel job advertisement and deciding whether to apply

performance_activity.instruction: Mark the required experience, shift hours, and contact method. Compare this short profile with the advertisement: Alex has one year of hotel reception experience, is free Saturday from nine to five, and can send a CV by email.
prompts: Does Alex fit the advertisement? Give two reasons.
Could Mina work the advertised Saturday shift?
